narration: The pipeline begins with multi-modal inputs, including a reconstructed 3D point cloud alongside multi-view RGB images and depth maps with camera poses.
In Step 1, a 3D superpoint is selected and projected across views via a histogram of projected points to identify the optimal pivot viewpoint.
SAM 2 performs promptable segmentation on the selected pivot view using the superpoint cue, generating an accurate initial 2D mask.
Using SAM 2 tracking augmented with 3D cues, the mask is propagated bidirectionally in forward and backward passes to produce a complete 2D mask track.
In Step 2, the multi-view 2D mask track is lifted into 3D space to form mask candidates, which are refined through geometric mask optimization.
The refined 3D proposals are aggregated into high-quality, class-agnostic 3D instance segmentations covering all objects in the scene.
Finally, the output stage integrates CLIP and LLM features to provide both open-vocabulary and open-ended 3D semantic instance labeling.
